meta.analysis_rules: Pre-registered single pass: boolean natural split; numeric median split on discovery seeds 143-151, threshold transferred unchanged to replication 152-163; gate = G1 discovery pooled ratio >= 2, G2 minority half >= 5% of intros on >= 3 of 6 variants, G3 ratio >= 2 on >= 3 of 6 variants, G4 ratio >= 2 on >= 3 replication seeds AND replication pooled >= 2; low-half zero events with non-zero high half counts as >= 2 and is flagged; zero/zero = not testable; gate evaluated on y_msmi only.
meta.deviation_from_methods_json: methods.json wrote dev-only seeds (90210 family); the authorising instruction superseded it with deterministic replay of the existing consumed tournament worlds (seeds 143-163) and forbade new seeds. No new seed or confirmation was created.

fidelity.note: byte-identical to sealed official control rows before any analysis ran

meta.selection_bias_caveat: Labels exist only for pairs greedy chose to introduce. Outcomes of unchosen pairs are counterfactual and unobservable, so every feature/conversion association here is conditional on selection and cannot be read causally or as counterfactual policy value.
